threads.body: This Bedrock snippet reads like `wrapBedrockRuntimeClient(...)` is sufficient on its own, but `AwsSdkTelemetry.wrapBedrockRuntimeClient()` only wraps an already-configured client; callers still need to register `telemetry.createExecutionInterceptor()` via `overrideConfiguration(...)` (as shown in the DynamoDB example and in Bedrock tests). Please clarify the text to say this is an additional step (like SQS), and consider capitalizing/being specific (e.g., “Bedrock Runtime async client”).
